added-date.description: When the breach was added to the notification service - not when it happened

breach-date.description: When the breach occurred, as far as the service knows

data-classes.description: A class of data exposed by the breach (e.g. `Email addresses`, `Passwords`, `Phone numbers`). One attribute per class

description.description: The service's own description of the breach

link.description: Link to the service's page for this breach

modification-date.description: When the service last changed its record of the breach

name.description: The breach as the service names it, stable across its API

pwn-count.description: How many accounts the breach exposed

sensitive.description: Whether the service treats the breach as sensitive, meaning membership is not publicly searchable

source.description: The breach notification service the record came from

title.description: Display name of the breach, where the service gives one distinct from `name`

verified.description: Whether the service considers the breach verified rather than claimed

description: A data breach in which accounts or personal data were exposed, as published by a breach notification service. Describes the breach itself, so that an address or account found in one links to the breach rather than restating it; `credential` holds what was exposed and `ail-leak` holds a leak as an analysis framework saw it.
name: breach
